'''Keegan Carlson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2000 Seattle tournament]] on 15 July 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down]], according to Douglas Harvilla's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1006">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-16-seattle-wa-7-15-00d1006/ seattle-wa-7-15-00], DeckTech (Douglas "Douglas" Harvilla, 16 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-16-seattle-wa-7-15-00d1006/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
